subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The novel’s intricate plot and rich character development kept readers ________(committed) from the beginning to the end.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"committed"** means to be dedicated or loyal to a cause, activity, or job. (प्रतिबद्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **She is **committed **to her studies and spends hours every day reading.
 
 
 
• **"Engaged"** refers to being involved or interested in something. (व्यस्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The students were deeply **engaged **in the interactive lecture.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **engaged**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Secluded** (अलग-थलग): Being isolated or hidden away.

 
 
• **Example:** The cottage was** secluded **in the mountains, far from any town.
 
 
 
• **Detached** (अलग): Separate or disconnected.
 
 
• **Example: **He seemed** detached **from the group, lost in his own thoughts.
 
 
 
• **Dismantled** (विघटित): Taken apart or disassembled.
 
 
• **Example:** The old factory was **dismantled **piece by piece.
